CVE-2024-26586.reason: The vulnerability involves the use of artificial intelligence (AI) in the Linux kernel. The vulnerability is related to the Spectrum-2 and newer ASICs, which use AI to manage the layout of the register that configures ACL groups (PAGT) and to detect the maximum number of ACLs in a group. The vulnerability is caused by a stack corruption issue that occurs when more than 16 ACLs in a group are required, which exceeds the maximum number of ACLs that can fit in the PAGT register. The vulnerability is resolved by limiting the maximum ACL group size to the minimum between what the firmware reports and the maximum ACLs that fit in the PAGT register.
